# Procedural API

<div class="doc-meta"><span class="doc-badge">Reference</span> Generated from <code>src/caffeine/script/api/procedural.json</code></div>

Deterministic noise, chunk streaming and terrain generation helpers for procedural worlds.

<!-- Generated by caffeine-website/scripts/generate-api-pages.py. Edit the engine JSON instead. -->

## Functions

### `caffeine.procedural.hash`

`hash(x, z, seed, salt) -> number`

Deterministic hash of a cell, seed and salt.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | Integer X. |
| `z` | number | Integer Z. |
| `seed` | number | Seed. |
| `salt` | number | Extra salt. |

**Returns:** `number` — Hash value (named hash01 in the engine).

**Example**

```lua
local r = caffeine.procedural.hash(3, 4, 42, 0)
```

### `caffeine.procedural.noise2d`

`noise2d(x, z, seed) -> number`

2D value noise.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | X coordinate. |
| `z` | number | Z coordinate. |
| `seed` | number | Seed. |

**Returns:** `number` — Noise value.

**Example**

```lua
local n = caffeine.procedural.noise2d(1.5, 2.5, 42)
```

### `caffeine.procedural.fbm2d`

`fbm2d(x, z, seed, octaves, lacunarity, persistence) -> number`

2D fractal Brownian motion noise.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | X coordinate. |
| `z` | number | Z coordinate. |
| `seed` | number | Seed. |
| `octaves` | number | Octave count. |
| `lacunarity` | number | Frequency multiplier per octave. |
| `persistence` | number | Amplitude multiplier per octave. |

**Returns:** `number` — Noise value.

**Example**

```lua
local h = caffeine.procedural.fbm2d(x * 0.02, z * 0.02, 42, 5, 2.0, 0.5)
```

### `caffeine.procedural.worldToChunk`

`worldToChunk(worldCoord, chunkSize) -> number`

Converts a world coordinate to a chunk index.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `worldCoord` | number | World coordinate. |
| `chunkSize` | number | Chunk size in world units. |

**Returns:** `number` — Chunk index.

**Example**

```lua
local cx = caffeine.procedural.worldToChunk(pos.x, 64)
```

### `caffeine.procedural.findTerrain`

`findTerrain() -> number`

Finds the terrain entity.

**Returns:** `number` — Terrain entity id, or 0 if none.

**Example**

```lua
local t = caffeine.procedural.findTerrain()
```

### `caffeine.procedural.getFocusChunk`

`getFocusChunk(directorId, chunkSize, focusId) -> table`

Returns the chunk the focus entity is in.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `directorId` | number | Entity id of the procedural world director. |
| `chunkSize` | number | Chunk size, used if the director has no procedural settings. |
| `focusId` | number | Focus entity id. Optional. |

**Returns:** `table` — Table with `cx` and `cz` (0, 0 if unavailable).

**Example**

```lua
local c = caffeine.procedural.getFocusChunk(dir, 64, player)
print(c.cx, c.cz)
```

### `caffeine.procedural.isChunkLoaded`

`isChunkLoaded(directorId, cx, cz) -> boolean`

Checks whether a chunk is loaded for the director.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `directorId` | number | Entity id of the procedural world director. |
| `cx` | number | Chunk X index. |
| `cz` | number | Chunk Z index. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true if the chunk is loaded.

**Example**

```lua
print(caffeine.procedural.isChunkLoaded(dir, 0, 0))
```

### `caffeine.procedural.unloadChunk`

`unloadChunk(directorId, cx, cz)`

Unloads a chunk of the director.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `directorId` | number | Entity id of the procedural world director. |
| `cx` | number | Chunk X index. |
| `cz` | number | Chunk Z index. |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.procedural.unloadChunk(dir, 0, 0)
```

### `caffeine.procedural.stream`

`stream(directorId, terrainId, cx, cz, preset)`

Streams chunks around the given chunk, adding procedural settings to the director if needed.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `directorId` | number | Entity id of the procedural world director. |
| `terrainId` | number | Terrain entity id. Optional. |
| `cx` | number | Chunk X index. |
| `cz` | number | Chunk Z index. |
| `preset` | string | Preset name. Optional. |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.procedural.stream(dir, caffeine.procedural.findTerrain(), 0, 0)
```

### `caffeine.procedural.generateTerrainChunk`

`generateTerrainChunk(terrainId, cx, cz, seed, preset)`

Generates one terrain chunk.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `terrainId` | number | Terrain entity id. |
| `cx` | number | Chunk X index. |
| `cz` | number | Chunk Z index. |
| `seed` | number | Seed. |
| `preset` | string | Preset name. Optional. |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.procedural.generateTerrainChunk(terrain, 0, 0, 42)
```

### `caffeine.procedural.spawnCube`

`spawnCube(directorId, cx, cz, x, y, z, sx, sy, sz) -> number`

Spawns a cube entity tagged with the director and chunk.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `directorId` | number | Entity id of the procedural world director. |
| `cx` | number | Chunk X index. |
| `cz` | number | Chunk Z index. |
| `x` | number | World X. |
| `y` | number | World Y. |
| `z` | number | World Z. |
| `sx` | number | Scale X. |
| `sy` | number | Scale Y. |
| `sz` | number | Scale Z. |

**Returns:** `number` — Id of the new entity, or 0 if no world.

**Example**

```lua
local c = caffeine.procedural.spawnCube(dir, 0, 0, 1, 0.5, 1, 1, 1, 1)
```

### `caffeine.procedural.fillTerrainNoise`

`fillTerrainNoise(terrainId, seed, amplitude)`

Fills the terrain heightmap with fractal noise.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `terrainId` | number | Terrain entity id. |
| `seed` | number | Seed. |
| `amplitude` | number | Height multiplier; results are clamped to 0..1. |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.procedural.fillTerrainNoise(terrain, 42, 1.0)
```
